reviews.title: Perfect app to track
reviews.text: I check it everyday to see how long it’s been since my last drink and it motivates me to keep going.

reviews.title: Best resource for quitting drinking
reviews.text: I suffered with severe alcoholism for almost a decade and found this app the 2nd time I tried to quit. I love that it does so much more than just track your sobriety count. It gives you information on ways your body and health is healing every day you’re alcohol free. It gives you a section to journal, track cravings, calming exercises, and even a great social community to post and interact with people who are going through the same thing as you. I feel really grateful to have found this app!

reviews.title: Best app for quit drinking
reviews.text: I love this app has everything you need all the tools and resources top notch app. You guys gave me resources for free. Love that it’s a free app to track your progress. Haven’t seen an app as good as this one. Usually don’t reviews on apps but this app was so good I just had to!

reviews.title: Enjoyable
reviews.text: I really like this app , it offer support and also offers a cut down limit , not just a fully quit . It quite easy to use and I like it marks every second you don’t drink . I would give this a 5 stars for how easy it is to use and how much I enjoy it .

reviews.title: Amazing!
reviews.text: Best app for no drinking I have ever seen by far!

reviews.title: simple and fair
reviews.text:
without pay, the app does what you would expect it to do; count the time of your sobriety.

surprisingly this is a mot more than what other apps of the same nature will do without pay. 
there’s a couple more features that could probably help those who want more stats and encouragement to keep going. i don’t know much about those features since i just wanted the basic timer

reviews.title: My app is my guide
reviews.text: I can’t believe how doing nothing more than working with an app could help me control my desire for alcohol. I’m taking the money I save and putting it in a savings account. And every day that I look at it I feel that the app is giving me an AttaGirl!

reviews.title: Doesn’t work

reviews.title: Great way to break the bad habit
reviews.text:
When you start to quit, you’re trying to overcome the urges and the associated dopamine hit that comes with it.

This app makes you look forward to the next goal. 15 minutes after quitting and you’re already getting benefits of stopping. 

Great app! Would love more quitting apps like this one!

reviews.title: Love this app!
reviews.text: This app has been so helpful in my recovery. It’s nice to have self guided meditation anytime I need. I like looking to see exactly how long I’ve been alcohol free and how much money I’ve saved.

reviews.title: Remember your Core value
reviews.text: Remembering why you started in the first place and it’s your life. You don’t get a second chance if you drink again..you can live the better, healthier version. The choice is your’s. This app helps me because it helps remind me of why I’m doing it and why I should not give up.
